column1: # --min_weight in {5,10,20,30,40,50}, sweeping the weight floor on the current
# default solver (relative=1, oldestsource=1 are now compiled defaults, so the
# rows inherit them). Under relative=1 min_weight does double duty: it is the
# source-selection floor AND the subtrahend in the transfer term
# wtmul*(source_weight - min_weight). Refines around the mw30 optimum found in
# the earlier rel1_mw sweep, and probes below the mw10 default down to 5.
